invariants.rationale: The execute method always returns the result of JavaWriteHelper.newInstance().write(...), which should not return null.
getWriteStatuses() returns the list of WriteStatus objects produced by the write operation and should not be null if write() succeeded.
A list's size is always non-negative; this captures the range on the output list.
Partition to replace file IDs information is expected to be present in a valid HoodieWriteMetadata instance.
The helper method should not return null if passed a valid write metadata, reflecting a successful internal API postcondition.
